summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py (thread-entry state set/cleared in run_async, not-running and same-thread checks, partial binding, invoke helper, run_coroutine_threadsafe). Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 9 tests; all pass when run with PYTHONPATH=src, since the venv's textual is an editable install of another copy. Nothing committed. Existing async tests in adjacent modules fail only because the venv lacks an async pytest plugin, which is pre-existing. Note: call_from_thread works under run()/run_async but not run_test, which bypasses run_async.
